description: A white shirt lies on a light wooden tabletop in front of you. The right hand reaches in from the right to pull the crumpled shirt toward the center while the left hand steadies it, then both hands lift and shake it open into a flat spread; next, the left hand and right hand fold the sides inward and then fold the long rectangle over again, pressing and smoothing the fabric until it becomes a compact, neatly folded bundle that the right hand picks up.
